import asyncio
import re
from functools import lru_cache
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# ruleid: in-process-cache-python
import cachetools
from django.db import models

TOKEN = re.compile(r"\w+")


class Settings:
    SPLIT = re.compile(",")


def words(text, pattern):
    """Runs SELECT * FROM users only in this sentence."""
    # ruleid: regex-built-in-function-python
    found = re.findall(r"\w+", text)
    dynamic = re.compile(pattern)
    # ruleid: bool-array-python
    seen = [False] * len(text)
    # ruleid: whole-row-sql-python
    query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s"
    columns = "SELECT id, name FROM users"
    count = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users"
    exists = "SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)"
    return found, dynamic, seen, query, columns, count, exists, TOKEN


# ruleid: in-process-cache-python
@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def square(value):
    return value * value


async def load(client, ids, links):
    for item in ids:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await client.get(item)
    # ruleid: sequential-awaits-python
    first = await client.get(1)
    second = await client.get(2)
    total = first + second
    third = await client.get(total)
    fourth = await client.get(third)
    # ruleid: url-parse-in-loop-python
    hosts = [urlparse(link).netloc for link in links]
    # ruleid: whole-entity-load-python
    user = User.objects.get(id=1)
    named = User.objects.filter(id=1).only("name")
    # ruleid: json-column-code
    settings = models.JSONField()
    body = client.response.json()
    return fourth, hosts, user, named, settings, body, cachetools, asyncio
